Definition: a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (figuratively); also (as observed) a usage (abstractly), or an example (concretely)
BiblicalUsage: 1) place of confinement, prison, guard, jail, guard post, watch, observance; 1a) jail, prison, guard-house; 1b) guard, guard post, act of guarding; 1c) observances
